snippet.title: This Worm Lives On Your Desktop 🐛 (Deskworm Trailer)
snippet.description:
🐛 Get Deskworm on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4044170/Deskworm/
Releasing: January 15, 2026!

ABOUT THE GAME 
Meet Deskworm, your new chaotic (but cute) desktop companion! Unlike other games, Deskworm lives directly on your screen, crawling over your windows and keeping you company while you work, study, play, or watch videos.

Whether you want a distraction or just a friend on your taskbar, this little worm is ready to move in.

FEATURES 
✨ Always on Top: Lives as an overlay on your actual desktop. 
🎨 Customization: Choose colors and hats to match your vibe. 
🍎 Interaction: Feed, play, and watch it react to your mouse. 
💤 Idle Mode: The perfect low-maintenance virtual pet.

Add to your Wishlist now & play on Jan 15! 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4044170/Deskworm/

#Deskworm #DesktopPet #IndieGame #VirtualPet #CozyGames #SteamRelease
